name: Flight to Auberdine
summary: You leave Teldrassil for Auberdine with a bundle of unusual fish specimens. Vesprystus sends you from Rut'theran Village by hippogryph to deliver them to Laird.

sections.title: Taking Wing to Darkshore
sections.body: Rut'theran Village is a sanctuary at the edge of the wider world for young adventurers leaving Teldrassil. A mundane ferry crosses the strait between the island and mainland Kalimdor, while night elves also travel by bonded hippogryph. Nessa Shadowsong entrusts you with a parcel of rare fish parts, and you take wing to reach the shores of Darkshore.

sections.title: Curious Catches
sections.body: Laird waits for Nessa's findings at the docks of Auberdine. He finds enormous scales as large as fists and a jawbone nearly twice the size of mainland specimens. The waters around the base of the World Tree seem to produce altered or abnormally large life, a curiosity tied to Teldrassil's potent, restless nature.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this flight?
aliases: why do i fly to auberdine
faq.answer: You carry unusual fish specimens caught around Rut'theran Village to Laird in Auberdine, while making the flight between settlements.

faq.q: Who sends the parcel, and what is inside it?
faq.answer: Nessa Shadowsong, a fisherwoman, sends the parcel. It holds fish specimens from Rut'theran Village's waters, including massive scales and an oversized jawbone.

faq.q: Why are the fish from Teldrassil so large?
faq.answer: Laird notes scales as big as a fist and a jawbone nearly twice normal size. Waters around Teldrassil's World Tree seem to foster magnified wildlife compared with the mainland shores of Darkshore.
Vesprystus is the hippogryph master at Rut'theran Village. He tends the night elven mounts and coordinates flights across the water to mainland Kalimdor.
Laird is a night elf fisherman in Auberdine on the coast of Darkshore. He studies local aquatic life and compares mainland catches with those near Teldrassil.

faq.q: Can you travel between Rut'theran and Auberdine without flying?
faq.answer: Yes. A regular ferry runs between the docks at Rut'theran Village and the pier at Auberdine, offering an alternative to the hippogryph flight.

angles.text: As a night elf, you take a hippogryph to Auberdine, a rite of passage for young kaldorei leaving Teldrassil for the ancestral mainland.
As an Alliance traveler, you can rely on hippogryphs to link coastal outposts across northern Kalimdor directly to the capital.
